about: How the President's own record shapes the address: which of the country's numbers each of the President's goals bears on, by the bill catalog's subject of that goal; how many numbers the address cites; and whether the agenda or the numbers come first. A President whose leading goal bears on a number opens with the numbers, and cites one more for each of their leading goals that bears on one; any other President opens with the agenda. It holds no sentences: the words are the opening-speech bank's.

addressNumbersAtLeast.note: How many of the country's numbers besides unemployment every address cites, before the President's own goals add more (play-first-09: at least three).

addressGoalsRead.note: How many of the President's goals, most wanted first, the address reads for the numbers they bear on: the three it asks for (Congress, the governors, the occasion).
